LinklyAPIKeyCredential.title: Linkly API Key
LinklyAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In Linkly, open Settings, then Account Settings, and copy your API key here. NoClick uses it to list your workspaces and access the workspace you select in each operation.

LinklyCreateConversionConfig.description: Report a conversion; an unattributed 202 response is discarded, not stored. Preserve attributed and event_id from the response.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the workspace. Required when authenticating with an API key. Omit it with an OAuth token, which is bound to one workspace.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

amount_cents.description: Value in the smallest currency unit. May be negative to record a refund or chargeback, which nets against earlier revenue.
amount_cents.title: Amount Cents

country.description: Two-letter country code for the conversion. Inferred for browser-side calls; supply it explicitly from a server-side integration, where the connecting address is your own infrastructure rather than the customer's.
country.title: Country

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to USD.
currency.title: Currency

event_id.description: Your identifier for this event. Used as an idempotency key — reporting the same value twice will not create a second conversion. Applies to any event type, not just purchases.
event_id.title: Event Id

event_type.description: Coarse type driving the funnel. `lead` establishes customer identity, `sale` records revenue. Defaults to `custom`.
event_type.title: Event Type

external_id.description: Your identifier for the customer. Send it on every event: it is what links a later server-side sale back to the click that produced the signup.
external_id.title: External Id

linkly_cid.description: The attribution token captured from the landing page URL. Omit if unavailable — the conversion is then recorded without a link attribution.
linkly_cid.title: Linkly Cid

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON, up to 10,000 bytes encoded.
metadata.title: Metadata

occurred_at.description: When the conversion happened. Defaults to now.
occurred_at.title: Occurred At

visitor_ip.description: The end customer's IP, when your server has it. Omit unless you do — for server-side calls Linkly otherwise records the connecting address as your server, not the customer, and excludes it from geographic reporting. Sending this asserts you have a lawful basis to share it. Never returned by the API.
visitor_ip.title: Visitor Ip

LinklyCreateConversionConfig.title: LinklyCreateConversionConfig

sticky_rotator.description: Rotator links only: send a returning visitor to the same destination as last time, remembered in a cookie for 30 days. Not available on privacy-mode links; turning privacy mode on switches it off.
sticky_rotator.title: Sticky Rotator

id.description: Link ID (include to update existing link)
id.title: Id

privacy_mode.description: Record clicks without personal data (no IP, location, network, user agent, referrer or query parameters; click times kept to the hour). Turning it on also clears tracking pixels, custom scripts, conversion tracking, webhooks and click notifications on the link, and click webhooks stop firing for it. Paid plans only.
privacy_mode.title: Privacy Mode

expiry_clicks.description: Expire link after this many clicks
expiry_clicks.title: Expiry Clicks

LinklyGetClickCountersConfig.description: Get click counts grouped by dimension; only the top 10,000 groups are returned, while total includes all groups.

counter.description: The dimension to group clicks by. Options: country, city, region, platform, destination, referer, bot_name, isp, link_id, remote_ip, top_params, ad_network, and the UTM dimensions utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term. Any other value returns 400. For `link_id` each `value` is the full Link object rather than a string; for `top_params` each item also carries a `key` (the parameter name).
counter.title: Counter

link_id.description: The id of a single Link
link_id.title: Link Id

start.description: The start date for the date range (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
start.title: Start

end.description: The end date for the date range (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
end.title: End

country.description: Filter by country using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code
country.title: Country

bots.description: Set to false to exclude bot clicks from the results
bots.title: Bots

unique.description: Set to true to only count unique clicks
unique.title: Unique

LinklyGetClickCountersConfig.title: LinklyGetClickCountersConfig

link_id.description: The id of a single Link
link_id.title: Link Id

link_ids.description: Filter clicks by multiple links. Provide a hyphen-separated list of link IDs.
link_ids.title: Link Ids

start.description: The start date for the date range (format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)
start.title: Start

end.description: The end date for the date range (format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)
end.title: End

country.description: Filter clicks by country using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code e.g US
country.title: Country

browser.description: Filter clicks by browser name e.g Chrome, Firefox, Safari
browser.title: Browser

platform.description: Filter clicks by platform/operating system e.g Windows, Mac, iOS, Android
platform.title: Platform

isp.description: Filter clicks by Internet Service Provider name
isp.title: Isp

bots.description: Set to false to exclude bot clicks from the results
bots.title: Bots

unique.description: Set to true to only include unique clicks in the results
unique.title: Unique

pivot.description: Return data as a matrix. When pivot=link_id, returns dates as rows and links as columns. CSV/TSV includes header rows for name, full_url, and id.
pivot.title: Pivot

timezone.description: The timezone to use for date/time calculations
timezone.title: Timezone

frequency.description: The frequency of data points in the response. Available options are 'day' (default) or 'hour'.
frequency.title: Frequency

LinklyListConversionsConfig.description: List conversions; pass since, then the last conversion ID as after while has_more is true.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the workspace. Required when authenticating with an API key. Omit it with an OAuth token, which is bound to one workspace.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

after.description: Return conversions recorded after this conversion `id`, oldest first. Use the `id` of the last conversion on the previous page.
after.title: After

since.description: Return conversions Linkly recorded at or after this time, oldest first. An ISO 8601 date (`2026-07-29`) or date-time (`2026-07-29T10:30:00Z`); a date-time without an offset is read as UTC.
since.title: Since

LinklyListConversionsConfig.title: LinklyListConversionsConfig

sort_by.description: Sort by field. Accepts any link column, plus the computed click aggregates: `clicks_total`, `clicks_today`, `clicks_previous_day`, `clicks_thirty_days`, `human_clicks_total`, `human_clicks_thirty_days`, `human_clicks_today`, `human_clicks_previous_day`.
sort_by.title: Sort By

filter.description: Filter links by exact field match. Composable — multiple filters are ANDed. e.g. filter[utm_campaign]=summer_sale&filter[utm_source]=newsletter

deleted.description: Return soft-deleted (trashed) links instead of active ones
deleted.title: Deleted
